headline: CAM, TT&A, JSA, Sidley Austin act on AceVector ₹420 crore IPO
sum: AceVector Limited has launched an initial public offering of equity shares amounting to ₹420 crore, comprising a fresh issue aggregating to ₹287 crore and an offer for sale aggregating to ₹133 crore by certain existing shareholders of the…
detail: AceVector Limited has launched an initial public offering of equity shares amounting to ₹420 crore, comprising a fresh issue aggregating to ₹287 crore and an offer for sale aggregating to ₹133 crore by certain existing shareholders of the Company. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised AceVector as well as Promoter Selling Shareholder Starfish I Pte. Ltd., a SoftBank entity, on this IPO. The transaction team advising the Company was led by Gokul Rajan (Partner, Regional Co-Head - Capital Markets - North), Aashima Johur (Partner) and Amitpal Singh (Partner), with support from Aditya Singh (Senior Associate), Associates Anjini Ganguly, Mahima Aggarwal and Soumya Mohanty.
